content: {"like": ["Dame Helen Mirren was better as Mrs Hitchcock.", "James D’Arcy’s portrayal of Anthony Perkins was uncanny and captured the dimensions of Perkins’s unhappy soul.", "Ralph Macchio managed to emit pathos in his brief screen time.", "The review notes that the master’s oeuvre will survive this biographical ordeal."], "dislike": ["Director Sacha Gervasi was a bitter disappointment and made Hitchcock appear as a nice, corpulent gentleman instead of an evil man.", "Sir Anthony Hopkins was only acceptable in name and was saddled with prosthetics and padding to make him resemble the director, resulting in a corpse-like appearance.", "The film feels like a television movie from the nineteen-seventies, far removed from the chilling, stylized, monstrous ethos of the original film.", "The scenes depicting the making of Psycho are not enough to redeem the failure of the film.", "The overall portrayal of Hitchcock and the film’s execution were unsatisfactory." ]}
